patthana15.49:1.1: ajjhattikaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ajjhattiko na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. bāhiraṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattiko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi.
patthana15.49:2.1: ajjhattikaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ajjhattiko na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. bāhiraṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ajjhattiko na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi, (abyākatamūlaṃ tīṇimeva.) no upādā
